content:
maddy: FYI saw a sharp uptick in validator.soft_coercion on assistant.tools.v2 this morning. Arrays being coerced to objects and routed to degen.

leo: Which model and env?

maddy: redwood-v1-std in prod-us-east, customer sandbox traffic. Example: {"tool_response":{"items":["x"]}} coerced to items:{name:"x"}.

sam: Soft coercion was by-design for compatibility but console visibility is zero.

console-bot: Alert: validation.coercion +600% over 2h for assistant.tools.v2 (sampling on).

dina: We should surface coercions in route UI and add a sampled payload pipeline (opt-in + redaction).

amy: Also tag telemetry with coercion_reason and include a billing flag for reconciliation.

leo: I'll own emitting validation.coercion events with fields: route, model_variant, coercion_type, coercion_reason, trace_id, sampled_payload_id. Sampling <1%.

sam: I'll instrument validator to emit tags + sampling hook to write redacted samples to S3 for opted projects and emit metric validation.coercion.count.

dina: I'll add a dashboard card: timeline of rejects/coercions/soft-fallbacks and a toggle to show samples (requires opt-in).

maddy: Can we target a tiny canary next week? If we surface this before strict validate rollouts it should reduce breakages.

leo: Timeline: event PR Thu EOD, validator sampling Tue, dashboard prototype Wed.

sam: Filing a short RFC on whether coercions count toward graceful-fallback SLOs.

dina: Ticket created ENG-9123 and assigned. Ping #eng-platform when PRs land. :thumbsup:
